protein: RNase III (rnc), the double-stranded RNA endoribonuclease
readout: Growth fitness relative to wild-type synonyms
assay_method: Site-saturation library of the whole rnc coding region on plasmid pRnc2-gGFP, transformed into rnc-minus E. coli SK7622 and grown for 10 generations of exponential growth in LB. Fitness w_i = ln(r*eps_i)/ln(r*eps_wtsyn) from the change in mutation frequency before and after growth, pooled over synonymous codons, reported as the variance-weighted mean of two replicas.
remark: The reference sequence is the 226-residue rnc coding region printed as the column header of the source matrix, byte-identical to UniProt P0A7Y0. There is no WT row: the source matrix leaves the wild-type residue blank at every position, wild type being the normalizing reference rather than a measured cell. wt_readout is 1 by the definition of w_i, which divides through by the wild-type synonym rate, rather than by measurement. The 225 nonsense measurements are dropped, a stop codon not being a substitution in this format. The article PDF could not be retrieved and is not redistributed in papers/: PMC serves an HTML interstitial in its place and the publisher returns 403, so only the open supplementary files are staged. Not extracted from this paper: the codon-level tables of Supplementary Data S4, S6 and S8, which measure the same variants at a finer granularity than this format carries; the per-replica columns, since the weighted mean is the value the paper analyses; and the k* alignment values of Supplementary Data S10, which are computed rather than assayed.

protein: RNase III (rnc), the double-stranded RNA endoribonuclease
readout: log10 enrichment ratio on transformation, relative to wild-type synonyms
assay_method: The same site-saturation library, transformed out of rnc-plus NEB5-alpha into rnc-minus E. coli SK7622. The transformation score is the log of the enrichment of a mutant relative to the enrichment of alleles synonymous for wild type, so a score of -1 is a 10-fold depletion in the SK7622 library. A single measurement, not replicated.
remark: The reference sequence is the 226-residue rnc coding region printed as the column header of the source matrix, byte-identical to UniProt P0A7Y0. There is no WT row: the source matrix leaves the wild-type residue blank at every position, wild type being the normalizing reference rather than a measured cell. wt_readout is 0 because the score is a log ratio against wild-type synonyms, which is 0 by construction.
